message: A little oasis. The garden is beautiful and the bakeries nearby are amazing.
Unreal location. The beach is two minutes away and the ferry into the city was the best commute I've ever had.
Nice modern apartment with a lovely view over the bay. Walking along the water in the evening was a highlight.
Lovely terrace and fun housemates. The Saturday market at Carriageworks was a great bonus.
Amazing ocean views from the terrace and a huge kitchen. Perfect for our family holiday.
Great room in a great house. Being two minutes from King Street meant I never ran out of places to eat.
Gorgeous cottage. The fireplace and the garden were our favourite parts.
We stayed here for a family reunion and it was perfect. The kids lived in the pool and we walked to Coogee for breakfast every morning.
Ideal for our family while we looked for a place to rent. Quiet complex and the station is close.
Beautifully styled apartment, and the timber kitchen is stunning. We walked to Balmoral Beach every morning.
Big room with a great ensuite, and the pool was a bonus. Very close to the station.
Comfortable and modern, with plenty of room for the three of us. The garage was a bonus in Leichhardt.
Cosy studio in a lovely old building. Taking the ferry from Neutral Bay to the city was a highlight.
Perfect for my conference at the uni, I could walk to everything. Compact but very well set up.
The city views at night were fantastic. Very handy for the Metro and the shops.
Spacious townhouse near the river. Unfurnished bedrooms, exactly as the listing said.
The ultimate beach house. Sitting on the deck after a swim was exactly what we needed. We'll be back next summer.
Waking up to kookaburras in the gum trees was magical. Such a peaceful place, and still close to the train.
Our kids didn't want to leave the pool. A big, comfortable home on a quiet street.
Sunny balcony and a really comfortable bed. Great restaurants a short walk away.
Such a warm welcome. The house is beautiful, the street is really peaceful and the train connections are great.
The view of the Harbour Bridge from the couch is incredible, especially at night. Easy train ride to the city for work.
Perfect for my exchange semester, UTS was a five-minute walk. The room is small but cosy.
Spacious and clean, with a great kitchen. The courtyard was perfect for morning coffee.
Beautiful house, even nicer than the photos. Marco was really helpful with tips for the coastal walk.
Handy for work in Parramatta and the townhouse was spotless. The courtyard was a nice spot for dinner.
Lots of space for our family while we settled into Sydney. Close to schools and the Metro.
Beautiful old terrace with heaps of character, and surprisingly quiet at night. The coffee on Victoria Street is the best.
Comfortable apartment right near the station and the shops. The car space was very handy.
Perfect for an early flight, the airport is two stops away. Clean and comfortable.
I was here for a nursing placement and it was ideal. The blockout curtains were a lifesaver after night shifts.
Olivia was a great host and the studio had everything I needed for a work trip.
Ideal for uni, the light rail stop is right there. Friendly housemates and a nice back deck.
Lovely bright room and the housemates made me feel at home straight away. The walk to uni through Glebe was a highlight.
A gorgeous little cottage. The picket fence and the courtyard made us feel like locals, and the ferry to the city was a treat.
Great family home with plenty of space for us and the dog. Daniel was easy to deal with.
Comfortable and quiet, and Mei Lin made sure I had everything I needed.
New, clean and quiet. Unfurnished as described, which suited us while our furniture was being shipped.
Loved the high ceilings and the view towards the harbour. Walked to Darling Harbour every evening and Raj had everything ready when I arrived.
Having my own ensuite made all the difference. Super close to the station, and the food in Burwood is amazing.
Everything was easy, from check-in to the pool. Priya left helpful notes about the area.
Spotless apartment with everything we needed for a week. Chloe even left boogie boards for us.
Plenty of room for two families, and the outdoor shower was a nice touch after the beach.
Cosy and private with its own entrance. A bit of a walk to the station, but a pleasant one.
Beautiful home and a short walk to the beach. Hannah thought of everything.
We loved the bushwalks nearby. The house is comfortable and full of light.
Cosy room in a great area. Old terraces are a bit chilly in winter, but there's a heater.
Very clean and modern, and close to the hospital where my wife was working. Mei Lin was a great host.
Clean and convenient, and the desk was handy for studying. It gets a bit noisy when the shopping centre closes at night.
Loved being close to Norton Street, so many good restaurants. The townhouse was clean and Sophie was lovely.
Clean, quiet room in a lovely bungalow. Good value with bills included.
Stylish apartment, and two bathrooms were a big plus for the two of us. The gym was great too.
Quiet, comfortable, and the pool was a lovely surprise. Easy bus to the city.
Quiet room in a nice old house, a short walk to the hospital. The kitchen is small but had everything I needed.
A lovely light studio with a view of the garden. Paddington is such a nice area to walk around.
Good value and super central. The housemates were quiet during exam time.
Convenient and modern. A bit of plane noise, but the windows block most of it.
Bright and modern, a good base for exploring the eastern suburbs.
Great little studio in a great area. The kitchenette is basic, but with so many restaurants nearby we hardly cooked.
Lovely house with plenty of space. The hill back up from the beach is steep, but the view is worth it.
Great spot for a family weekend. The second bedroom is on the small side, but the location makes up for it.
Comfy house with a big backyard. We used it as a base for day trips to the Blue Mountains.
Sam was a brilliant host and the cottage was spotless. We loved the pubs around Balmain.
Great location near the markets and plenty of cafes. Three people share the bathroom, so mornings can get busy, but everyone was considerate.
Lovely relaxed house close to the water. A long train ride from the city, but worth it.
Big room, good air con and a quiet house. The laundry is shared, but there was never a wait.
Comfortable bed and a great shower. The window faces a busy street, so bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper.
Good-sized townhouse with a nice little courtyard. Quick train to the city.
Fantastic views and a comfortable bed. The lifts were slow at peak times, but that's a small thing.
Charming and well located. The stairs are steep, so travel light.
Charming and cosy. The second bedroom is small, which was fine for our kids.
Hannah was quick to reply and left a guide to the best spots in Glebe. Clean, quiet and good value.
Spotless studio and only a short walk to Central. Check-in was easy and Sam replied to every message within minutes.
Waking up to the ocean view was amazing. Five minutes to the beach and plenty of cafes nearby.
Bright room in a lovely old terrace and the shared kitchen was always clean. A bit of street noise on Friday night.
Great location and a comfortable bed. Street parking was hard to find on the weekend.
Perfect for our family weekend. The kids loved the pool and the kitchen had everything we needed.
Compact but really well designed. Fast Wi-Fi made it easy to work from the studio.
Such a charming cottage. The garden is beautiful and it felt like home from the moment we arrived.
Modern apartment with a great view of the city lights. Close to the station and the shopping centre.
Spacious, on a quiet street and with a big backyard. Priya left a lovely welcome basket.
Lots of natural light and a nice balcony for morning coffee. Would stay again.
Plenty of space for the three of us and a short walk to Westfield and the train.
Second time staying here and it was just as good. Olivia's local tips were spot on.
